name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
summary: Both sides share confidential information, for example while exploring a deal, and agree to protect it.

roles.name: Party 1
roles.description: One of the two parties. The terms are mutual.

roles.name: Party 2
roles.description: The other party.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.description: How Confidential Information may be used.
fields.default: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the agreement starts.

fields.label: MNDA Term
fields.description: "fixed" if the agreement expires after a number of years, or "untilTerminated" if it continues until a party terminates it.

fields.label: MNDA Term years
fields.description: The number of years for a fixed MNDA Term.

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality
fields.description: "fixed" if confidentiality lasts a number of years from the Effective Date, or "perpetual" if it lasts forever.

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality years
fields.description: The number of years for a fixed Term of Confidentiality.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state or other place whose law governs, such as Delaware.

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.description: The city or county and state for courts, such as New Castle, DE.

fields.label: MNDA Modifications
fields.description: Any changes to the Standard Terms. Use an empty string only if the user asks to remove existing modifications.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
summary: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software or a SaaS product.
termsTitle: Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement Standard Terms Version 3.0

roles.name: Provider
roles.description: The company supplying the Cloud Service.

roles.name: Customer
roles.description: The company buying and using the Cloud Service.

fields.label: Cloud Service
fields.description: The product being sold.

fields.label: Order Date
fields.description: The date this order starts.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: How long each subscription runs, such as 1 year. It renews automatically unless a party gives notice.

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.description: The deadline for giving notice of non-renewal, such as 30 days before the Subscription Period ends.

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: The amounts Customer pays.

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.description: The support Provider gives during the Subscription Period.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the Key Terms start.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The law that governs the agreement, such as Delaware.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, such as the courts in New Castle, DE.

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: The limit on each party's total liability, such as an amount or a multiple of Fees.

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.description: The third-party claims Provider protects Customer against.

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.description: The third-party claims Customer protects Provider against.

fields.label: DPA
fields.description: The data processing agreement between the parties, if they have one.

name: Service Level Agreement
summary: Uptime and support response commitments, and the remedies if they're missed. Used with a Cloud Service Agreement.
termsTitle: Common Paper Service Level Agreement Standard Terms Version 2.0

roles.name: Provider
roles.description: The company supplying the Cloud Service.

roles.name: Customer
roles.description: The company using the Cloud Service.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The existing agreement this attaches to, usually a Cloud Service Agreement: its title and date.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: The Subscription Period the commitments apply to.

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.description: The monthly availability Provider aims for, such as 99.9%. Uptime commitments apply only if this is set.

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.description: The credit Customer can earn if availability falls below the Target Uptime.

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.description: Planned downtime that doesn't count against the Target Uptime.

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.description: How quickly Provider aims to respond to support requests. Response commitments apply only if this is set.

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.description: The credit Customer can earn if Provider misses the Target Response Time.

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.description: Where Customer sends support requests, such as an email address.

name: Data Processing Agreement
summary: How a provider processes a customer's personal data as a processor or subprocessor, including international transfers and security incidents. Supplements an existing agreement.

roles.name: Provider
roles.description: The company processing personal data for Customer.

roles.name: Customer
roles.description: The company whose personal data is processed.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The existing agreement this supplements: its title and date.

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.description: What Provider does with the personal data and why.

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.description: How long the processing continues.

fields.label: Frequency of Transfer
fields.description: How often personal data is transferred, such as continuously.

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.description: Whose personal data is processed, such as Customer's employees.

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.description: The kinds of personal data processed, such as names and email addresses.

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.description: Any sensitive personal data processed, such as health data.

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
fields.description: Any extra protections for Special Category Data.

fields.label: Approved Subprocessors
fields.description: The subprocessors Customer approves, with each one's country and processing tasks.

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.description: Where Customer sends security requests.

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.description: The security standards Provider is audited against.

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.description: The EU member state whose law governs the EEA transfer clauses, for restricted transfers from the EEA.

name: Design Partner Agreement
summary: Gives a partner early access to a product for internal business use in exchange for feedback.

roles.name: Provider
roles.description: The company offering early access to its product.

roles.name: Partner
roles.description: The company getting early access and giving feedback.

fields.label: Product
fields.description: The product or services the partner gets early access to.

fields.label: Program
fields.description: The design partner activities the partner takes part in, such as feedback sessions.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the agreement starts.

fields.label: Term
fields.description: How long the partner has access.

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: Any amounts Partner pays Provider.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The law that governs the agreement, such as Delaware.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, such as the courts in New Castle, DE.

excludedTerms.reason: Collected as each party's notice address.

roles.name: Customer
roles.description: The company receiving the services.

fields.label: Effective Date

fields.description: The law that governs the agreement, such as Delaware.

fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, such as the courts in New Castle, DE.

fields.label: DPA

fields.label: Insurance Minimums
fields.description: Any minimum insurance coverage each party must carry.

fields.label: Services
fields.description: The work Provider will perform.

fields.label: Deliverables
fields.description: What Provider will hand over, if anything.

fields.label: SOW Term
fields.description: When this SOW starts and ends.

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: The amounts Customer pays, and how invoices are sent.

fields.label: Payment Period
fields.description: How long Customer has to pay each invoice, such as 30 days.

fields.label: Time of Assignment
fields.description: When rights in the Deliverables pass to Customer, such as on payment.

fields.label: Rejection Period
fields.description: How long Customer has to reject a Deliverable.

fields.label: Resubmission Period
fields.description: How long Provider has to correct and resubmit a rejected Deliverable.

fields.label: Customer Obligations
fields.description: Anything Customer must do for the Services to go ahead.

name: AI Addendum
summary: Adds terms for AI services included in a product to an existing agreement, covering input, output and model training.
termsTitle: Common Paper AI Addendum Standard Terms Version 1.0

roles.name: Provider
roles.description: The company supplying the AI services.

roles.name: Customer
roles.description: The company using the AI services.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The existing agreement this supplements: its title and date.

fields.label: Training Data
fields.description: Any data Provider may use to train models. Unless Training Data and Training Purposes are both identified, Provider may not use Customer's Inputs or Outputs to train any model.

fields.label: Training Purposes
fields.description: What Provider may train models for, if training is allowed.

fields.label: Training Restrictions
fields.description: Any limits on training, if training is allowed.

fields.label: Improvement Restrictions
fields.description: Any limits on using Input, Output and Training Data to improve the AI system.
